prompt: `Closes #12` sits in a pull request that merges into a long-lived feature branch, not `main`. Does issue #12 close?
explanation: The auto-close behavior triggers when the pull request reaches the default branch. Merging elsewhere (like a staging or feature branch) leaves the issue open — the link stays, the close does not fire.

options.text: No — the automatic close fires only on merges into the default branch
Yes — any merge closes the linked issue
Yes, but only after a maintainer approves
No — closing keywords never work on branches
